title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A web application designed to help users practice and solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Editor
features.description: An integrated code editor with support for multiple programming languages and syntax highlighting.

features.name: Online Judge System
features.description: An automated system to evaluate code submissions and provide real-time feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Personalized user accounts to track progress, view solved problems, and maintain a history of submissions.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A ranking system to display top performers and encourage competition among users.

constraints: Requires real-time evaluation of code submissions
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, and submission history
